title: The world has made sex louder… but not healthier.
paragraphs: The world has made sex louder… but not healthier.
Everyone is talking about intimacy.
Almost no one is talking about God's design.
That's why so many marriages are struggling—not because God failed, but because we've listened to the wrong voices.
God never intended marriage to be built on selfish desire, unrealistic expectations, or the world's definition of love.
He designed it to reflect covenant, sacrifice, joy, faithfulness, and Christ's love for His Church.
If you're married—or preparing for marriage—this message could transform the way you see one of God's greatest gifts.

📖 NEW RELEASE
How to Enjoy God's Design for Sex in Marriage
This isn't another worldly relationship book.
It's a biblical guide that helps husbands and wives rediscover intimacy the way God intended—without shame, without confusion, and without compromising His truth.
Whether your marriage is thriving, struggling, or simply needs fresh encouragement, this book points you back to God's original design.
Inside you'll discover:
✅ Why God created sexual intimacy as a blessing—not a burden
✅ The difference between covenant love and selfish desire
✅ How emotional, spiritual, and physical intimacy work together
✅ Biblical ways to rebuild trust after failure and hurt
✅ How to overcome shame through God's grace
✅ Practical habits that strengthen marriage for a lifetime
✅ Scriptures and reflections to help you grow together in Christ
⚔️ Most people...
• Learn about sex from culture.
• Chase feelings instead of faithfulness.
• Seek pleasure before commitment.
• Expect marriage to fix problems only Christ can heal.
✝️ Few people...
• Build intimacy on biblical truth.
• Serve their spouse with humility.
• Protect their marriage with intentionality.
• Honour God even in the most private areas of life.
Which group will you belong to?
